name: Watchgoose
description: Connect one Watchgoose project to inspect checks and status history. Read-only access is the default. With explicit read-and-write consent, the connector can inspect recent signals and integrations and create, update, pause, resume, or delete checks.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Watchgoose to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Watchgoose to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.watchgoose.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Watchgoose MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Watchgoose provides these MCP tools: create_check, delete_check, get_check, list_channels, list_checks, list_flips, list_pings, pause_check, resume_check, and update_check.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Watchgoose?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Watchgoose in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Watchgoose requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Watchgoose is developed by Watchgoose. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
